name: Facebook Pages
summary: Facebook's pages for businesses and public figures.

flows.title: Create a Page
steps: Click Pages on the left, then click Create Page.
Select Public Page, then click Next. Click Get Started.
Add the Page's name and category, add an optional bio, and click Create Page.
Add information such as contact info, location and hours, and click Next. Add profile and cover photos, edit the action button, and click Next.
Connect WhatsApp to the Page or click Skip, invite friends to connect with the Page and click Next, then select notification settings and click Done.

flows.title: Post on your Page
steps: Switch to the Page you want to use.
From the top of your Feed, click "What's on your mind, [Page name]?"
Create your post, then click Next.

flows.title: Invite friends to follow your Page
steps: Go to the Page you'd like to share with your friends.
Click Options below the Page's cover photo and select Invite Friends.
Click Switch below Switch profiles in the pop-up box.
Click the names of the profiles you want to invite to follow the Page.
